question: Retrieve the average confidence score of Assertions that are supported by other Assertions and tagged with the Tag named 'Important'.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[:Supports]->(a2:Assertion), (a1)-[:TaggedWith]->(:Tag {name: 'Important'}) RETURN AVG(a1.confidence_score) AS avg_confidence

question: Find the average confidence score of Assertions sourced from articles published after January 1, 2025.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Source) WHERE s.publication_date > date('2025-01-01') RETURN avg(a.confidence_score) AS average_confidence_score

question: Retrieve the average confidence score of Assertion nodes that are supported by other Assertion nodes with a support strength greater than 0.5 and are sourced from Source nodes published after 2020.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[s:Supports]->(a2:Assertion)-[sf:SourcedFrom]->(src:Source) WHERE s.support_strength > 0.5 AND src.publication_date > date('2020-12-31') RETURN AVG(a2.confidence_score) AS average_confidence_score

question: Count the number of distinct Source nodes that are connected to Assertion nodes through the SourcedFrom relationship, where the Assertion nodes contradict other Assertion nodes with a contradiction severity less than 0.3.
gql: MATCH (src:Source)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(a1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion) WHERE c.contradiction_severity < 0.3 RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT src) AS distinct_source_count

question: Find pairs of Concept nodes that are related through a common Assertion node where one supports the other with a strength greater than 0.8. Return the names of these concept pairs along with the support strength.
gql: MATCH (c1:Concept)<-[:RelatesTo]-(a1:Assertion)-[s:Supports]->(a2:Assertion)-[:RelatesTo]->(c2:Concept) WHERE s.support_strength > 0.8 RETURN c1.name, c2.name, s.support_strength

question: Retrieve the average confidence score of assertions that support other assertions within the 'Data Science' domain.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[:Supports]->(a2:Assertion)-[:ClassifiedUnder]->(d:Domain {name: 'Data Science'}) RETURN AVG(a1.confidence_score) AS average_confidence_score

question: Identify all pairs of Assertion nodes where one supports the other with a support strength greater than 0.7. Return the statements of both assertions and the support strength.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[s:Supports]->(a2:Assertion) WHERE s.support_strength > 0.7 RETURN a1.statement, a2.statement, s.support_strength

question: Find the average confidence score of Assertion nodes that are supported by other Assertion nodes with a support strength greater than 0.5.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[s:Supports]->(a2:Assertion) WHERE s.support_strength > 0.5 RETURN AVG(a1.confidence_score) AS average_confidence

question: Count how many distinct Experts have endorsed Concepts that are part of the 'Data Science' domain.
gql: MATCH (:Domain {name: 'Data Science'})<-[:ClassifiedUnder]-(c:Concept)<-[:EndorsedBy]-(e:Expert) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT e) AS expert_count

question: Find the average confidence score of assertions that contradict other assertions with a severity greater than 0.7.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion) WHERE c.contradiction_severity > 0.7 RETURN AVG(a1.confidence_score) AS average_confidence

question: Find the average confidence score of assertions that were sourced from articles published after January 1, 2025, and are related to concepts in the 'Healthcare' domain.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Source {source_type: 'Article'})-[:ClassifiedUnder]->(d:Domain {name: 'Healthcare'}) WHERE s.publication_date > date('2025-01-01') RETURN AVG(a.confidence_score) AS average_confidence_score

question: Find all Assertions that contradict other Assertions with a severity greater than 0.7, returning the statements of both Assertions and the contradiction severity.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion) WHERE c.contradiction_severity > 0.7 RETURN a1.statement AS Statement1, a2.statement AS Statement2, c.contradiction_severity AS Severity

question: Retrieve all Source nodes that have been used to source Assertions which contradict other Assertions, including the contradiction severity and the titles of the sources.
gql: MATCH (s:Source)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(a1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion) RETURN s.title AS source_title, c.contradiction_severity AS severity LIMIT 10

question: Identify the average confidence score of assertions that contradict other assertions and are sourced from articles published after January 1, 2025.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion), (a1)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Source) WHERE s.publication_date > date('2025-01-01') RETURN AVG(a1.confidence_score) AS average_confidence

question: Identify Sources that are linked to Assertions which contradict other Assertions, and list the Source titles along with the contradiction severity.
gql: MATCH (src:Source)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(ast1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(ast2:Assertion) RETURN src.title AS source_title, c.contradiction_severity AS severity ORDER BY severity DESC

question: Find all Sources that are linked to Assertions with a validity start date in 2024 and group them by source type, counting how many assertions each type supports.
gql: MATCH (s:Source)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(a:Assertion) WHERE a.validity_start >= date('2024-01-01') AND a.validity_start < date('2025-01-01') RETURN s.source_type, COUNT(a) AS assertion_count ORDER BY assertion_count DESC

question: Retrieve the average confidence score of Assertions that contradict other Assertions with a contradiction severity greater than 0.5. Group the results by the evidence type of the contradicting assertions.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion) WHERE c.contradiction_severity > 0.5 RETURN a2.evidence_type, AVG(a1.confidence_score) AS avg_confidence

question: Find the average confidence score of Assertions that are sourced from articles published after January 1, 2025, and tagged with 'Machine Learning'.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Source)-[:TaggedWith]->(t:Tag {name: 'Machine Learning'}) WHERE s.publication_date > date('2025-01-01') RETURN AVG(a.confidence_score) AS average_confidence

question: Retrieve all assertions that contradict other assertions with a severity greater than 0.7, including the statements of both contradicting assertions.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion) WHERE c.contradiction_severity > 0.7 RETURN a1.statement AS assertion1_statement, a2.statement AS assertion2_statement

question: Retrieve all Assertion nodes that contradict other Assertions with a severity greater than 0.7, including the statement of both the original and contradicting Assertion, and order them by contradiction severity.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion) WHERE c.contradiction_severity > 0.7 RETURN a1.statement AS original_statement, a2.statement AS contradicting_statement, c.contradiction_severity ORDER BY c.contradiction_severity DESC

question: Retrieve the average confidence score of Assertions that have been endorsed by Experts with the specialization 'Data Science' and are sourced from Sources published after 2020.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:EndorsedBy]->(e:Expert {specialization: 'Data Science'}), (a)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Source) WHERE s.publication_date > date('2020-12-31') RETURN avg(a.confidence_score) AS average_confidence_score

question: Retrieve all assertions that support other assertions with a support strength higher than 0.8 and are contradicted with a severity less than 0.5, showing the assertion statements.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[s:Supports]->(a2:Assertion), (a1)-[c:Contradicts]->(a3:Assertion) WHERE s.support_strength > 0.8 AND c.contradiction_severity < 0.5 RETURN a1.statement

question: Identify Sources that have been cited by more than three Assertions, displaying the source title and the number of citations.
gql: MATCH (s:Source)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(a:Assertion) RETURN s, COUNT(a) AS citation_count NEXT RETURN s.title AS SourceTitle, citation_count

question: Identify the top 5 Domain nodes with the highest number of associated Assertion nodes that have a confidence score greater than 0.7, and return their names along with the count of such assertions.
gql: MATCH (d:Domain)<-[:ClassifiedUnder]-(a:Assertion) WHERE a.confidence_score > 0.7 RETURN d.name AS domain_name, COUNT(a) AS high_confidence_assertions_count ORDER BY high_confidence_assertions_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the total number of Projects that apply Concepts tagged with 'Blockchain' and sourced from publications authored by 'John Doe'.
gql: MATCH (p:`Project`)<-[:AppliedIn]-(c:Concept)-[:TaggedWith]->(t:Tag{name:'Blockchain'}) RETURN COUNT(p) AS total_projects

question: Identify all Assertions with a confidence score higher than 0.9 that are supported by at least two other Assertions, and return their statements along with the count of supporting Assertions.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)<-[s:Supports]-(:Assertion) WHERE a.confidence_score > 0.9 RETURN a, COUNT(s) AS support_count NEXT RETURN a.statement AS assertion_statement, support_count

question: Find the total number of projects that apply concepts which are endorsed by experts specialized in 'Machine Learning'.
gql: MATCH (p:`Project`)<-[:AppliedIn]-(c:Concept)-[:EndorsedBy]->(e:Expert{specialization:'Machine Learning'}) RETURN COUNT(p) AS project_count

question: What are the titles of sources that cite assertions which contradict other assertions with a contradiction severity less than 0.3?
gql: MATCH (s:Source)<-[sf:SourcedFrom]-(a1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion) WHERE c.contradiction_severity < 0.3 RETURN DISTINCT s.title AS source_title

question: Calculate the average support strength for each Assertion that supports more than one other Assertion, displaying the statement of the supporting Assertion and its average support strength.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[s:Supports]->(:Assertion) RETURN a, AVG(s.support_strength) AS avg_support_strength, COUNT(s) AS support_count NEXT RETURN a.statement AS assertion_statement, avg_support_strength

question: Retrieve the top 5 Sources by the number of Assertions they have supported, including only those Sources published after 2022. Show the Source title and the count of supporting Assertions.
gql: MATCH (s:Source)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(a:Assertion) WHERE s.publication_date > date('2022-12-31') RETURN s.title, COUNT(a) AS assertion_count ORDER BY assertion_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find all Assertion nodes that support others with a strength greater than 0.9 and are contradicted with a severity less than 0.5. Include the statement of such Assertions and their confidence scores.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[s:Supports]->(a2:Assertion), (a1)-[c:Contradicts]->(a3:Assertion) WHERE s.support_strength > 0.9 AND c.contradiction_severity < 0.5 RETURN a1.statement, a1.confidence_score

question: Return the names and publication dates of Sources that were used to source Assertions contradicting other Assertions with a severity greater than 0.6, ordered by publication date.
gql: MATCH (s:Source)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(a1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion) WHERE c.contradiction_severity > 0.6 RETURN s.title, s.publication_date ORDER BY s.publication_date

question: Retrieve all Assertions supported by at least two other Assertions with a support strength greater than 0.8 and show the statement of the target Assertion along with the total support strength it received.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[s:Supports]->(a2:Assertion) WHERE s.support_strength > 0.8 RETURN a2, SUM(s.support_strength) AS total_support, COUNT(a1) AS supporter_count NEXT RETURN a2.statement, total_support

question: Find the total number of Projects that have applied Concepts tagged with 'AI' and were sourced from publications authored by 'John Doe'.
gql: MATCH (p:`Project`)<-[:AppliedIn]-(c:Concept)-[:TaggedWith]->(t:Tag{name:'AI'}) RETURN COUNT(p) AS total_projects

question: Calculate the average confidence score of Assertions that are contradicted by at least three other Assertions with a contradiction severity greater than 0.6.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)<-[c:Contradicts]-(contradicting:Assertion) WHERE c.contradiction_severity > 0.6 RETURN a, COUNT(contradicting) AS num_contradictions NEXT RETURN AVG(a.confidence_score) AS average_confidence_score

question: Calculate the average confidence score of Assertions that are classified under the 'Technology' Domain and have been endorsed by Experts specializing in 'Computer Science'.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:ClassifiedUnder]->(d:Domain {name: 'Technology'}), (a)-[:EndorsedBy]->(e:Expert {specialization: 'Computer Science'}) RETURN AVG(a.confidence_score) AS average_confidence_score

question: Retrieve the average confidence scores of Assertions grouped by their evidence types, considering only those Assertions that are supported by at least one other Assertion.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:Supports]->(:Assertion) RETURN a.evidence_type AS evidence_type, AVG(a.confidence_score) AS average_confidence_score ORDER BY average_confidence_score DESC

question: Find the total number of projects that have applied concepts which are related to other concepts with a relationship strength greater than 0.7.
gql: MATCH (p:`Project`)<-[:AppliedIn]-(c1:Concept)-[r:RelatesTo]->(c2:Concept) WHERE r.relationship_strength > 0.7 RETURN COUNT(p) AS project_count

question: What are the titles and publication dates of Sources that are cited in Assertions contradicting other Assertions with a severity greater than 0.5?
gql: MATCH (s:Source)<-[sf:SourcedFrom]-(a1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(:Assertion) WHERE c.contradiction_severity > 0.5 RETURN DISTINCT s.title, s.publication_date

question: What is the average confidence score of Assertions that relate to Concepts within the 'Finance' domain and have been contradicted with a severity higher than 0.6?
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[r:RelatesTo]->(c:Concept)-[:ClassifiedUnder]->(d:Domain {name: 'Finance'}), (a1)-[ct:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion) WHERE ct.contradiction_severity > 0.6 RETURN AVG(a1.confidence_score) AS average_confidence_score

question: Find all assertions supported by other assertions with a support strength greater than 0.7 and sourced from reports published in 2023.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[s:Supports]->(a2:Assertion)-[:SourcedFrom]->(src:Source {source_type: 'Report'}) WHERE s.support_strength > 0.7 AND src.publication_date >= date('2023-01-01') AND src.publication_date < date('2024-01-01') RETURN a1.assertion_id, a2.assertion_id, s.support_strength

question: Find all assertions that are supported by at least two other assertions with a support strength greater than 0.75 and return their statements along with the average support strength.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[s:Supports]->(a2:Assertion) WHERE s.support_strength > 0.75 RETURN a2, AVG(s.support_strength) AS avg_support_strength, COUNT(a1) AS support_count NEXT RETURN a2.statement AS assertion_statement, avg_support_strength

question: What are the top 5 Sources by the number of Assertions they have sourced, where those Assertions have a confidence score above 0.8?
gql: MATCH (s:Source)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(a:Assertion) WHERE a.confidence_score > 0.8 RETURN s, COUNT(a) AS assertion_count NEXT RETURN s.title, assertion_count ORDER BY assertion_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the top 5 Domains by the total number of supporting relationships between their associated Assertions. Return Domain names and the count of support relationships.
gql: MATCH (d:Domain)<-[:ClassifiedUnder]-(a1:Assertion)-[s:Supports]->(a2:Assertion) RETURN d, COUNT(s) AS support_count NEXT RETURN d.name, support_count ORDER BY support_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the average confidence score of assertions that are sourced from publications authored by 'John Doe' and are tagged with the tag named 'Machine Learning'.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Source {author: 'John Doe'}), (a)-[:TaggedWith]->(t:Tag {name: 'Machine Learning'}) RETURN AVG(a.confidence_score) AS avg_confidence_score

question: Find the average confidence score of Assertions that are tagged with 'Climate Change' and have been sourced from 'Scientific Journal' type sources.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:TaggedWith]->(t:Tag {name: 'Climate Change'}), (a)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Source {source_type: 'Scientific Journal'}) RETURN AVG(a.confidence_score) AS AverageConfidenceScore

question: Find the average confidence score of assertions that contradict other assertions with a severity greater than 0.5 and are sourced from academic papers.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion) WHERE a1.contradiction_severity > 0.5 AND a2.evidence_type = 'Academic Paper' RETURN AVG(a1.confidence_score) AS AverageConfidenceScore

question: Retrieve the titles and authors of Sources that have been cited for Assertions which either support or contradict other Assertions with a strength/severity greater than 0.75.
gql: MATCH (s:Source)<-[sf:SourcedFrom]-(a1:Assertion)-[r:Supports|Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion) WHERE (r.support_strength > 0.75 OR r.contradiction_severity > 0.75) RETURN DISTINCT s.title, s.author

question: Find all Assertions that contradict at least one other Assertion with a severity greater than 0.7 and are supported by at least two Assertions with a support strength greater than 0.8. Return the statement and confidence score of such Assertions.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(:Assertion) WHERE c.contradiction_severity > 0.7 RETURN a NEXT MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[s:Supports]->(a) WHERE s.support_strength > 0.8 RETURN a, COUNT(a1) AS support_count NEXT RETURN a.statement, a.confidence_score

question: Identify the top 3 Domains with the highest number of contradictory Assertions (based on the 'Contradicts' relationship) and display the domain name along with the count of contradictions.
gql: MATCH (d:Domain)<-[:ClassifiedUnder]-(a1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion) RETURN d, COUNT(c) AS contradiction_count NEXT RETURN d.name, contradiction_count ORDER BY contradiction_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find all Sources that have been cited for both supporting and contradicting Assertions, and list the source titles along with the number of supporting and contradicting citations.
gql: MATCH (s:Source)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(a1:Assertion)-[sup:Supports]->(a2:Assertion) RETURN s, COUNT(sup) AS support_citations, COUNT(con) AS contradict_citations NEXT RETURN s.title, support_citations, contradict_citations

question: Determine the average confidence score of Assertions that contradict other Assertions with a severity greater than 0.5 and are endorsed by Experts specialized in 'Cybersecurity'.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion)<-[:EndorsedBy]-(e:Expert {specialization: 'Cybersecurity'}) WHERE c.contradiction_severity > 0.5 RETURN AVG(a1.confidence_score) AS average_confidence_score

question: Identify the top 5 Domains by the total number of Assertions classified under them, where those Assertions have been supported by at least one other Assertion with a support strength greater than 0.5.
gql: MATCH (d:Domain)<-[:ClassifiedUnder]-(a1:Assertion)<-[s:Supports]-(a2:Assertion) WHERE s.support_strength > 0.5 RETURN d, COUNT(a1) AS assertion_count NEXT RETURN d.name, assertion_count ORDER BY assertion_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: For each Domain, calculate the total number of Assertions and the average confidence score of these Assertions, considering only those Domains that have more than 10 associated Assertions.
gql: MATCH (d:Domain)<-[:ClassifiedUnder]-(a:Assertion) RETURN d, COUNT(a) AS assertion_count, AVG(a.confidence_score) AS avg_confidence NEXT RETURN d.name, assertion_count, avg_confidence

question: Calculate the average support strength for each Assertion that has been contradicted by at least one other Assertion, and return the Assertion statement along with its average support strength.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)<-[s:Supports]-(:Assertion) RETURN a, AVG(s.support_strength) AS avg_support_strength NEXT MATCH (a)-[:Contradicts]->(:Assertion) RETURN a.statement, avg_support_strength

question: Find the average confidence score of Assertions that contradict other Assertions with a severity greater than 0.5 and are classified under the domain 'Healthcare'.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion), (a1)-[:ClassifiedUnder]->(d:Domain) WHERE c.contradiction_severity > 0.5 AND d.name = 'Healthcare' RETURN AVG(a1.confidence_score) AS average_confidence

question: What is the total number of unique Domains associated with Concepts that have been endorsed by Experts specialized in 'Data Science' and have a validity start date after 2020?

question: Retrieve the names of sources and their publication dates for sources that have been cited in sourcing assertions which both support and contradict other assertions, ensuring each relationship has a strength/severity greater than 0.7.
gql: MATCH (s:Source)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(a:Assertion)-[sp:Supports]->(:Assertion), (a)-[ct:Contradicts]->(:Assertion) WHERE sp.support_strength > 0.7 AND ct.contradiction_severity > 0.7 RETURN DISTINCT s.title, s.publication_date

question: What is the average confidence score of Assertions that are related to Concepts in the 'Healthcare' domain, endorsed by Experts specialized in 'Medical Research', and sourced from publications after 2020?
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:RelatesTo]->(c:Concept)-[:ClassifiedUnder]->(d:Domain {name: 'Healthcare'}), (a)-[:EndorsedBy]->(e:Expert {specialization: 'Medical Research'}), (a)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Source) WHERE s.publication_date > date('2020-12-31') RETURN AVG(a.confidence_score) AS avg_confidence_score

question: List all domains and the average confidence score of assertions classified under each domain, considering only those assertions that have been sourced from sources published after 2022.
gql: MATCH (d:Domain)<-[:ClassifiedUnder]-(a:Assertion)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Source) WHERE s.publication_date > date('2022-12-31') RETURN d.name, AVG(a.confidence_score) AS avg_confidence_score

question: Calculate the total number of assertions that are supported by at least three other assertions and are also tagged with more than two tags.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)<-[s:Supports]-(:Assertion) RETURN a, COUNT(s) AS support_count, COUNT(t) AS tag_count NEXT RETURN COUNT(a) AS total_assertions

question: Find the average confidence score of Assertions that are classified under the 'Healthcare' domain and have been supported by at least two other Assertions.
gql: MATCH (d:Domain)<-[:ClassifiedUnder]-(a:Assertion) WHERE d.name = 'Healthcare' RETURN a NEXT MATCH (a)<-[:Supports]-(s:Assertion) RETURN a, COUNT(s) AS support_count NEXT RETURN AVG(a.confidence_score) AS avg_confidence_score

question: Retrieve the top 5 domains with the highest number of assertions that contradict other assertions, including the count of such contradictions.
gql: MATCH (d:Domain)<-[:ClassifiedUnder]-(a1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion) RETURN d.name AS domain_name, COUNT(c) AS contradiction_count ORDER BY contradiction_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Identify the top 5 Domains with the highest average confidence scores of associated Assertions, excluding those Domains where the average confidence score is below 0.5.
gql: MATCH (d:Domain)<-[:ClassifiedUnder]-(a:Assertion) RETURN d.name AS domain_name, AVG(a.confidence_score) AS avg_confidence_score ORDER BY avg_confidence_score DESC LIMIT 5

question: Retrieve the titles of Sources that have been cited for sourcing Assertions contradicting other Assertions with a severity greater than 0.7, grouped by source title and sorted by the count of such contradictions in descending order.
gql: MATCH (src:Source)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(a1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion) WHERE c.contradiction_severity > 0.7 RETURN src, COUNT(c) AS contradiction_count NEXT RETURN src.title, contradiction_count ORDER BY contradiction_count DESC

question: Find the average relationship strength of 'RelatesTo' edges connecting Concepts that are also connected via 'Supports' relationships with a support strength greater than 0.5.
gql: MATCH (c1:Concept)-[r:RelatesTo]->(c2:Concept), (c1)-[s:Supports]->(c2:Concept) WHERE s.support_strength > 0.5 RETURN AVG(r.relationship_strength) AS avg_relationship_strength

question: Find the average confidence score of Assertions that are tagged with 'Climate Change' and sourced from publications authored by 'Dr. Jane Smith'.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:TaggedWith]->(:Tag {name: 'Climate Change'}), (a)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Source {author: 'Dr. Jane Smith'}) RETURN AVG(a.confidence_score) AS AverageConfidenceScore

question: Find the average support strength of assertions that contradict other assertions with a contradiction severity less than 0.3 and are sourced from academic journals.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Source {source_type: 'Academic Journal'}) WHERE c.contradiction_severity < 0.3 RETURN AVG(a1.confidence_score) AS avg_support_strength

question: Find Assertion nodes with confidence score greater than 0.38 and return their connected Source nodes via SourcedFrom edges along with the citation field of the edge, limited to 10 results.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion {assertion_id: "AST00069"})-[e:SourcedFrom]->(n:Source) WHERE e.citation = "Across next box cultural member." AND a.confidence_score > 0.38 RETURN n, e.citation LIMIT 10

question: Find path information from Assertion to Source where citation is 'Across next box cultural member.' and confidence_score is greater than 0.3.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[e:SourcedFrom]->(n:Source) WHERE e.citation = "Across next box cultural member." AND a.confidence_score > 0.3 RETURN n, a.confidence_score LIMIT 10

question: Find article nodes authored by 'Alexandra Garner'.
gql: MATCH (n:Source) WHERE n.author = "Alexandra Garner" RETURN n LIMIT 10

question: Find SourcedFrom edges and corresponding Source nodes related to Assertion ID 'AST00069'.
gql: MATCH (n1:Assertion)-[e:SourcedFrom]->(n2:Source) WHERE n1.assertion_id = "AST00069" RETURN n1, e, n2 LIMIT 10

question: Find Source nodes associated with Assertion nodes and the SourcedFrom edges between them, returning at most 10 records.
gql: MATCH (n1:Assertion)-[e:SourcedFrom]->(n2:Source) RETURN e, n2 LIMIT 10

question: Find all Assertion nodes reachable from Source nodes within 1 to 3 hops where the Source title is 'People stage bag share', returning at most 5 records.
gql: MATCH (n1:Source)-[e]-{1,3}(n2:Assertion) WHERE n1.title = "People stage bag share" RETURN n1, n2 LIMIT 5

question: Find Source node information with title 'People stage bag share'.
gql: MATCH (n:Source) WHERE n.title = "People stage bag share" RETURN n LIMIT 10

question: Find articles authored by 'Alexandra Garner' and return their associated assertion information.
gql: MATCH (nodes_1:Source) WHERE nodes_1.author = "Alexandra Garner" RETURN nodes_1 NEXT MATCH (nodes_1)<-[edges_1:SourcedFrom]-(nodes_2:Assertion) RETURN nodes_2, nodes_1, edges_1 LIMIT 10

question: Find the Source node with source_id 'SRC00000' and limit the result to one.
gql: MATCH (n:Source) WHERE n.source_id = "SRC00000" RETURN n LIMIT 1

question: Find all Source nodes connected to the specified Assertion node within 1 to 3 hops range.
gql: MATCH (n1:Assertion)-[e]-{1,3}(n2:Source) WHERE n1.assertion_id = "AST00069" RETURN n1, n2 LIMIT 5

question: Find two-hop paths from Assertion nodes to Source nodes where the Source title is 'People stage bag share' and the Assertion assertion_id is not equal to 'AST00069', returning paths limited to one result.
gql: MATCH p = (n1:Assertion)-[e1]-(x)-[e2]-(n2:Source) WHERE n2.title = "People stage bag share" AND n1.assertion_id <> "AST00069" RETURN p LIMIT 1

question: Count the number of Assertion nodes associated with the Source node with source_id 'SRC00000'.
gql: MATCH (n1:Source)-[]->(n2:Assertion) WHERE n1.source_id = "SRC00000" RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT n2) as count_alias

question: Count the number of Assertion nodes associated with the Source node with publication_date '2025-11-03'.
gql: MATCH (n1:Source)-[]->(n2:Assertion) WHERE n1.publication_date = "2025-11-03" RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT n2) as count_alias

question: Count the number of distinct Assertion nodes associated with the Source node with title 'People stage bag share'.
gql: MATCH (n1:Source)-[]->(n2:Assertion) WHERE n1.title = "People stage bag share" RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT n2) AS count_alias

question: Find the average confidence score of assertions sourced from publications authored by 'Dr. Jane Smith' and tagged with 'Machine Learning'.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Source {author: 'Dr. Jane Smith'}), (a)-[:TaggedWith]->(t:Tag {name: 'Machine Learning'}) RETURN AVG(a.confidence_score) AS avg_confidence_score

question: Find assertions that contradict other assertions with a severity greater than 0.5 and were sourced from publications after January 1, 2020.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion), (a1)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Source) WHERE c.contradiction_severity > 0.5 AND s.publication_date > date('2020-01-01') RETURN a1.statement, a2.statement, c.contradiction_severity

question: Find all assertions that contradict other assertions which were sourced from articles published in 2025, providing the statement of the contradicting assertion and its contradiction severity.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Source) WHERE s.publication_date >= date('2025-01-01') AND s.publication_date <= date('2025-12-31') RETURN a1.statement, c.contradiction_severity

question: Find the number of assertions supported by at least two other assertions with a support strength greater than 0.7.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[s:Supports]->(a2:Assertion) WHERE s.support_strength > 0.7 RETURN a2, count(s) AS support_count NEXT FILTER support_count >= 2 RETURN count(DISTINCT a2) AS num_supported_assertions

question: Find the top 5 experts who have endorsed the most assertions, along with the number of endorsements and their specialization.
gql: MATCH (e:Expert)<-[:EndorsedBy]-(a:Assertion) RETURN e.name, e.specialization, COUNT(a) AS endorsement_count ORDER BY endorsement_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: List all domains and the total number of concepts and assertions classified under each domain, sorted by the total count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (d:Domain)<-[:ClassifiedUnder]-(entity) WHERE entity:Concept OR entity:Assertion RETURN d.name, COUNT(entity) AS total_entities ORDER BY total_entities DESC

question: Find the average confidence score of assertions that are endorsed by experts specialized in 'Machine Learning' and sourced from publications authored by 'John Doe'.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:EndorsedBy]->(e:Expert {specialization: 'Machine Learning'}), (a)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Source {author: 'John Doe'}) RETURN AVG(a.confidence_score) AS avg_confidence_score

question: Identify domains that classify both concepts and assertions, and count how many of each type are associated with these domains.
gql: MATCH (d:Domain)<-[:ClassifiedUnder]-(entity) RETURN d.name, entity:Concept AS is_concept, entity:Assertion AS is_assertion, COUNT(entity) AS entity_count

question: Find the average confidence score of assertions that are classified under the domain named 'Artificial Intelligence' and have been endorsed by experts specialized in 'Machine Learning'.
gql: MATCH (d:Domain {name: 'Artificial Intelligence'})<-[:ClassifiedUnder]-(a:Assertion)-[:EndorsedBy]->(e:Expert {specialization: 'Machine Learning'}) RETURN AVG(a.confidence_score) AS avg_confidence_score

question: Retrieve all assertions supported by at least two other assertions and sort them by their confidence score in descending order.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[:Supports]->(a2:Assertion)<-[:Supports]-(a3:Assertion) WHERE a1.assertion_id <> a3.assertion_id RETURN a2.assertion_id, a2.confidence_score ORDER BY a2.confidence_score DESC

question: Find the average confidence score of assertions sourced from publications authored by 'John Doe'.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Source {author: 'John Doe'}) RETURN AVG(a.confidence_score) AS avg_confidence_score

question: Retrieve the names of organizations in the 'Healthcare' industry that were founded before the year 2000, along with their founding dates.

question: Retrieve the top 5 sources by the number of assertions they have sourced, including the source title and the count of assertions.
gql: MATCH (s:Source)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(a:Assertion) RETURN s.title, COUNT(a) AS assertion_count ORDER BY assertion_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Retrieve the average confidence score of assertions supported by other assertions with evidence type 'Empirical Data'.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[:Supports]->(a2:Assertion {evidence_type: 'Empirical Data'}) RETURN AVG(a1.confidence_score) AS average_confidence_score

question: Find the average confidence score of assertions that are supported by at least two other assertions and belong to the 'Machine Learning' domain.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:Supports]->(b:Assertion) RETURN a, COUNT(b) AS support_count NEXT FILTER support_count >= 2 MATCH (a)-[:ClassifiedUnder]->(d:Domain{name:'Machine Learning'}) RETURN AVG(a.confidence_score) AS avg_confidence_score

question: Find the average confidence score of assertions that are supported by at least two other assertions.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)<-[:Supports]-(s1:Assertion), (a)<-[:Supports]-(s2:Assertion) WHERE s1 <> s2 RETURN avg(a.confidence_score) AS average_confidence

question: Find the average confidence score of assertions supported by other assertions within the 'Science' domain.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[:Supports]->(a2:Assertion)-[:ClassifiedUnder]->(d:Domain {name: 'Science'}) RETURN AVG(a1.confidence_score) AS avg_confidence_score

question: Find all assertions with a validity period overlapping the year 2023 and supported by at least one other assertion.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:Supports]->(:Assertion) WHERE a.validity_start <= date('2023-12-31') AND a.validity_end >= date('2023-01-01') RETURN a.assertion_id, a.statement, a.validity_start, a.validity_end

question: Count the number of assertions per evidence type that contradict other assertions, and order the results by count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:Contradicts]->(:Assertion) RETURN a.evidence_type, COUNT(*) AS contradiction_count ORDER BY contradiction_count DESC

question: Find the average confidence score of assertions that are supported by at least two other assertions and were sourced from publications authored by 'John Doe'. Return the average confidence score.

question: Retrieve the average confidence score of assertions that are tagged with 'AI' and were sourced from publications authored by 'John Doe'.

question: Find the average confidence score of assertions that are sourced from articles authored by 'Alexandra Garner'.

question: Retrieve the titles of sources that have been cited for assertions with a confidence score above 0.9, grouped by source title and sorted by the count of citations in descending order.

question: Retrieve the names and publication dates of sources that have been cited in assertions with a confidence score greater than 0.8.

gql: MATCH (d:Domain)<-[:ClassifiedUnder]-(a1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion) WHERE c.contradiction_severity > 0.8 RETURN d.name, AVG(c.contradiction_severity) AS avg_severity

question: Find all assertions that are supported by at least one other assertion with a support strength greater than 0.8 and contradicted by another assertion with a severity greater than 0.7, returning the assertion statement and its average support strength.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)<-[s:Supports]-(sa:Assertion), (a)-[c:Contradicts]->(ca:Assertion) WHERE s.support_strength > 0.8 AND c.contradiction_severity > 0.7 RETURN a.statement, AVG(s.support_strength) AS avg_support_strength

question: Find the total number of assertions supported by other assertions with a support strength greater than 0.7, grouped by the evidence type of the supporting assertion.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[s:Supports]->(a2:Assertion) WHERE s.support_strength > 0.7 RETURN a1.evidence_type, COUNT(*) AS total_supported

question: Determine the average relationship strength between concepts that are both tagged with 'Climate Change' and sourced from the same publication.
gql: MATCH (c1:Concept)-[:TaggedWith]->(t:Tag {name: 'Climate Change'}), (c2:Concept)-[:TaggedWith]->(t), (c1)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Source)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(c2), (c1)-[r:RelatesTo]->(c2) RETURN AVG(r.relationship_strength) AS avg_relationship_strength

question: Which sources have been cited for assertions that contradict other assertions with a severity greater than 0.7? Return the source titles and the count of such citations.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[c:Contradicts]->(a2:Assertion), (a1)-[s:SourcedFrom]->(src:Source) WHERE c.contradiction_severity > 0.7 RETURN src.title AS source_title, COUNT(s) AS citation_count

question: What are the names and confidence scores of assertions that are supported by at least two other assertions with support strengths greater than 0.5?
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)-[s:Supports]->(a2:Assertion) WHERE s.support_strength > 0.5 RETURN a2, COUNT(s) AS support_count NEXT FILTER support_count >= 2 RETURN a2.statement, a2.confidence_score

question: Find the total number of assertions sourced from publications authored by 'Dr. Jane Smith' and tagged with 'Machine Learning'.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Source), (a)-[:TaggedWith]->(t:Tag) WHERE s.author = 'Dr. Jane Smith' AND t.name = 'Machine Learning' RETURN COUNT(a) AS total_assertions

question: Return the titles of sources and the total number of assertions derived from each source, where the assertions have a confidence score greater than 0.9.
gql: MATCH (s:Source)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(a:Assertion) WHERE a.confidence_score > 0.9 RETURN s.title, COUNT(a) AS high_confidence_assertions

question: Find all sources that have contributed to assertions with a confidence score higher than 0.9, listing the source title and the average confidence score of related assertions.
gql: MATCH (s:Source)<-[:SourcedFrom]-(a:Assertion) WHERE a.confidence_score > 0.9 RETURN s, AVG(a.confidence_score) AS avg_confidence NEXT RETURN s.title AS source_title, avg_confidence

question: Find all assertions with validity periods overlapping the year 2023 and supported by at least one other assertion with a support strength greater than 0.8. Return the assertion statement, its validity start and end dates, and the highest support strength it received.
gql: MATCH (a1:Assertion)<-[s:Supports]-(a2:Assertion) WHERE s.support_strength > 0.8 AND a1.validity_start <= date('2023-12-31') AND a1.validity_end >= date('2023-01-01') RETURN a1.statement, a1.validity_start, a1.validity_end, MAX(s.support_strength) AS max_support_strength

question: Calculate the average confidence score of assertions grouped by their evidence type, and identify the evidence type with the highest average confidence.

question: List all assertions with a confidence score higher than the average confidence score of assertions endorsed by 'Dr. Jane Smith'.
gql: MATCH (e:Expert{name:'Dr. Jane Smith'})-[:EndorsedBy]->(a:Assertion) RETURN avg(a.confidence_score) AS avg_confidence NEXT MATCH (assert:Assertion) WHERE assert.confidence_score > avg_confidence RETURN assert

question: List all sources published by 'Alexandra Garner' and sort them by publication date in ascending order.
gql: MATCH (s:Source) WHERE s.author = 'Alexandra Garner' RETURN s ORDER BY s.publication_date ASC

question: Is there an organization named 'Barker-Knight'?

question: Find assertions with a validity start date after January 1, 2024, and a non-null evidence type, sorted by validity start date in descending order.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion) WHERE a.validity_start > date('2024-01-01') AND a.evidence_type IS NOT NULL RETURN a ORDER BY a.validity_start DESC

question: Identify organizations founded after January 1, 2010, in the 'Technology' industry, and sort them by their founding date in ascending order.

question: Retrieve assertions with a confidence score greater than 0.8 and evidence type 'Observational', sorted by their validity start date in ascending order.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion) WHERE a.confidence_score > 0.8 AND a.evidence_type = 'Observational' RETURN a ORDER BY a.validity_start ASC

question: Find all sources that are linked to assertions with a confidence score greater than 0.9 and their publication dates.

question: Find all assertions with a confidence score greater than 0.8 and a non-null evidence type, sorted by their validity start date in descending order.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion) WHERE a.confidence_score > 0.8 AND a.evidence_type IS NOT NULL RETURN a ORDER BY a.validity_start DESC

question: Find assertions with a validity start date after January 1, 2024, and a confidence score greater than 0.75, sorted by validity start date in ascending order.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion) WHERE a.validity_start > date('2024-01-01') AND a.confidence_score > 0.75 RETURN a ORDER BY a.validity_start ASC

question: Find all assertions that are supported by assertions sourced from articles authored by 'Alexandra Garner'.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:SourcedFrom]->(s:Source) WHERE s.author = 'Alexandra Garner' RETURN a NEXT MATCH (b:Assertion)-[:Supports]->(a) RETURN b

question: Find all assertions with a confidence score greater than the confidence score of the assertion with ID 'AST00069'.
gql: MATCH (a:Assertion{assertion_id:'AST00069'}) RETURN a.confidence_score AS target_score NEXT MATCH (b:Assertion) WHERE b.confidence_score > target_score RETURN b

question: Identify all projects that started after the start date of the project named 'Harness Distributed Platforms'.
gql: MATCH (p:`Project`{name:'Harness Distributed Platforms'}) RETURN p.start_date AS reference_date NEXT MATCH (pr:`Project`) WHERE pr.start_date > reference_date RETURN pr

question: Find all 2-hop paths starting from an Assertion node with assertion_id 'AST00069' connecting to other nodes, ensuring the end node is not the same Assertion node.
gql: MATCH p = (n1:Assertion)-[e1]-(x)-[e2]-(n2) WHERE n1.assertion_id = "AST00069" AND n2.assertion_id <> "AST00069" RETURN p LIMIT 5

question: Retrieve up to 10 assertions along with their source and relationship where the source's title is 'People stage bag share'.
gql: MATCH (nodes_1:Source) WHERE nodes_1.title = "People stage bag share" RETURN nodes_1 NEXT MATCH (nodes_1)<-[edges_1:SourcedFrom]-(nodes_2:Assertion) RETURN nodes_2, nodes_1, edges_1 LIMIT 10

question: List one-hop paths from assertions to sources where the source's URL is 'http://wise.org/', including the connecting edge.
gql: MATCH (n1:Assertion)-[e:SourcedFrom]->(n2:Source) WHERE n2.url = "http://wise.org/" RETURN n1, e, n2 LIMIT 10

question: Find up to 5 nodes connected to a Source node with url 'http://wise.org/' within 1 to 3 hops.
gql: MATCH (n1:Source)-[e]-{1,3}(n2) WHERE n1.url = "http://wise.org/" RETURN n1, n2 LIMIT 5

question: Find variable-length paths (1 to 3 hops) between a Source node with url 'http://wise.org/' and an Assertion node, returning up to 5 pairs of connected nodes.
gql: MATCH (n1:Source)-[e]-{1,3}(n2:Assertion) WHERE n1.url = "http://wise.org/" RETURN n1, n2 LIMIT 5

question: Retrieve a two-hop path where the first node is an Assertion with assertion_id 'AST00069' and the second node is a Source with a different title than the first Source connected to it.
gql: MATCH p = (n1:Assertion)-[e1]-(x)-[e2]-(n2:Source) WHERE n1.assertion_id = "AST00069" AND n2.title <> "People stage bag share" RETURN p LIMIT 1

question: Identify variable-length paths between a Source node with author 'Alexandra Garner' and any Assertion nodes within 1 to 3 hops.
gql: MATCH (n1:Source)-[e]-{1,3}(n2:Assertion) WHERE n1.author = "Alexandra Garner" RETURN n1, n2 LIMIT 5

question: Combine two-hop and three-hop paths starting from a Source node titled 'People stage bag share', ensuring end nodes are Sources with titles different from the start node.

question: Find Assertions that are sourced from a Source with source_id 'SRC00000' and have a confidence score greater than 0.3, returning the related edge property citation along with the Assertion node.

question: Find two-hop and three-hop paths starting from an Assertion node with assertion_id 'AST00069' and ending at another Assertion node with a different assertion_id.
